name: Signal Array Turns
effect: Reveal the top 2 cards of the shared relic/event deck. The active player may put them back in any order.
role: Pre-breach omen. The cosmonaut relay dish moves without command and points at a coordinate no scheduled satellite should occupy.

narrative.summary: The first visible sign is not in the reactor. It is outside in the snow, where the signal array turns twelve degrees toward an empty part of the sky. Telemetry officers call it a servo error until the dream monitors repeat the same coordinate.
narrative.character_pressure: Karpova understands the value of the anomaly before the scientists do. Elena suspects the coordinate is being answered. Orlov wants another diagnostic pass.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Simple top-deck control establishes Closed City's signal/reveal identity.
Can be promoted to playable deck before Leak markers exist.

name: Dream Monitors Synchronize
effect: Move 1 temporary combat marker, such as Shield, +ATK, +MOVE, Pounce, Slow, or Marked, from one character to another character within 3 tiles. Spirit Ember cannot be moved this way.
role: Elena's dream work stops being observation and becomes connection. Private symbols begin moving through machines and bodies.

narrative.summary: In Elena Morozova's lab, three sleeping subjects produce the same waveform. The line bends into geometry. The machines are not recording dreams anymore. They are letting dreams touch one another.
narrative.character_pressure: Elena sees proof. Orlov sees contamination. Zoya smiles before she wakes.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Uses the same status-marker vocabulary already emerging in Closed City character drafts.
Explicitly excludes Spirit Ember to protect Level 3 progression rules.

name: Reactor Prayer
effect: Choose one of your characters. That character takes 1 damage, then reveal the top card of the shared relic/event deck. You may leave it on top or place it on the bottom.
role: Radiation behaves like language. The reactor does not simply emit energy; it seems to ask for attention, pain, and interpretation.

narrative.summary: The instruments record radiation in repeating structures too intentional to dismiss. Orlov calls it noise. Elena calls it grammar. Karpova calls it leverage.
narrative.character_pressure: The city begins paying for information with bodies.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Risk/reward effect supports Closed City's dangerous-knowledge identity.
May need balance review because damage-for-deck-control can become very efficient.

name: Closed City Incident
effect: Place 2 Leak markers on different empty tiles within 2 of the center tile. Then reveal the top card of the shared relic/event deck. The active player may leave it on top or place it on the bottom.
role: Central Closed City story event. The reactor opens inward while Elena's remote-viewing work, cosmonaut signal systems, and anomalous radiation create the first major Convergence breach.

narrative.summary: At 02:17 local time, the reactor pulse, orbital receiver, and dream monitors synchronize around the same impossible symbol. The facility does not explode outward. It opens inward. For seventeen seconds, the Closed City exists inside overlapping realities.
witness_fragments: A drowned city behind reactor glass.
Snow falling upward in a sealed hallway.
Dead soldiers reflected in blank monitors.
A white tiger walking past locked doors.
Ocean pressure cracking concrete that never became wet.
narrative.story_consequence: Dr. Mikhail Orlov is found unconscious with circular light-burn marks on his palms. Dr. Elena Morozova is not found. The first MythCards artifacts begin appearing afterward.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Effect introduces Closed City Leak markers and deck manipulation without requiring a full scenario system.
May need balance review because it combines hazard placement with top-card control.
If Leak markers are not available in a prototype build, use placed object/status markers as a temporary stand-in.

name: Seventeen Seconds
effect: The active player's first movement action this turn may move through 1 occupied tile, placed object, or Leak marker, but must end on an empty tile.
role: For seventeen seconds, architecture loses its authority. Corridors overlap with dream routes, drowned streets, snowfields, and rooms that were never built.

narrative.summary: The final surviving clock record says the impossible lasted seventeen seconds. Everyone inside those seconds remembers a different room. Some remember no room at all.
narrative.character_pressure: Nikolai finds a service route where none exists. VERA-7 accepts a path no map confirms.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Temporary phase movement gives Closed City a distinct breach-route feel.
Needs rules review for interaction with mounted characters.

name: Elena Missing In The Signal
effect: Choose one allied character. Remove one harmful temporary combat marker from that character, then move that character 1 tile to an empty adjacent tile.
role: Elena disappears, but her work keeps creating routes, protections, and messages through the breach.

narrative.summary: After the white light, Elena Morozova is not found. Her notes remain. Her voice does not. Yet systems she built continue making choices that look too much like care.
narrative.character_pressure: Yuri wants extraction. Orlov wants explanation. Karpova wants access. None of them can prove whether Elena is dead, hidden, transformed, or answering.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
A defensive/repositioning event that expresses Elena's absent presence.
Can be reviewed against Dr. Elena Morozova's character-card mechanics to avoid overlap.

name: The First Card Appears
effect: Reveal the top 3 cards of the shared relic/event deck. Choose 1 relic or event among them and put it on top. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.
role: The first physical MythCards artifact appears near Orlov's coma bed, proving the Convergence can make symbols into objects.

narrative.summary: Dreams can be dismissed. Witnesses can be threatened. Machines can be recalibrated. But an object can be held. The first card appears beside Orlov's pillow in a sealed medical room rimmed with frost.
narrative.character_pressure: For Orlov, it suggests his unconscious mind is organizing the worlds. For Karpova, it proves the breach can produce valuable artifacts. For Elena, if she is still alive inside the signal, it may be a message.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Search/reorder effect expresses the first card as artifact evidence.
May be too strong in small decks; tune top-card count during playtest.

name: Semyonov Orders Silence
effect: Until the start of the active player's next turn, characters cannot reveal cards from the shared relic/event deck. Already revealed cards remain revealed.
role: The visible military authority tries to bury the truth before panic, Karpova, or the breach can use it.

narrative.summary: Colonel Semyonov can lock doors, confiscate papers, threaten witnesses, and order silence. What he cannot do is make the city stop dreaming.
narrative.character_pressure: Semyonov believes secrecy is survival. Karpova believes secrecy is ownership. The difference matters to everyone trapped between them.

review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
A temporary anti-reveal/control event that gives Semyonov a story presence without making him the primary Leader card.
May need wording updates if reveal effects are uncommon in a given prototype build.
